messages:
Sophie M.: quick thread — assembling the benchmark narrative for launch. need a short set of deliverables: 2 hero charts (latency vs $/token & throughput per-dollar by slice), 2-line positioning blurb, and one explainer slide for tradeoffs. who's owning what? :eyes:
Eli P.: I can own the positioning blurb and the slide that explains tradeoffs. will draft a 2-sentence hook + 1 supporting datapoint.
Jordan D.: i'll take the hero charts visuals. prefer a small-multiples sparklines approach so we can show distributions across seq lengths.
Marco L.: data ready — i've exported latency & cost per-token for 3 model families across 4 sequence-length buckets. can share csv. thinking normalized cost-per-inference on y-axis and p50 latency on x.
Sophie M.: exact slices we want to highlight: short chat (<=64), search snippet (<=256), doc summarize (>=1024), and embeddings-style small batch. keep it customer-oriented.
Marco L.: noted. csv columns: model, seq_bucket, batch_size, p50_latency_ms, cpu_tokens_cost_usd, gpu_tokens_cost_usd, throughput_rps. sending link in a sec.
DevOpsBot: exported file available: https://internal.redwood/s3/benchmarks/1717254321/latency_cost_export.csv :file_folder:
Jordan D.: for visuals i'd like two charts: 1) scatter latency vs cost with model family color + seq_bucket facets, 2) bar chart throughput-per-dollar for common batch sizes. both should be PNG + svg.
Eli P.: messaging: top line = "Right-sized inference: get predictable latency without paying for peak GPU". supporting = "Redwood's routing and batching shave 2–5x cost for long-tail workloads while preserving p95 latency for short chat." want numbers from Marco to back the 2–5x claim.
Marco L.: preliminary numbers: long doc summarize (>=1024) -> quantized q4 variants + batching = ~3.4x cost reduction vs unoptimized float32. short chat (<=64) -> p50 28ms on Dedicated, cost delta negligible vs hosted. will run a quick verification and post updated table by EOD.
Sophie M.: great. can we get a single callout stat for the slide: "3x cost reduction on long sequences without increasing average latency" — is that defensible?
Marco L.: probably yes but tweak to "up to 3.4x". prefer conservative: "~3x" and cite test config.
Eli P.: agree with conservative wording. include test config footnote: model family, quantization, batch size, HW type.
Jordan D.: visual copy ask: short caption under scatter: "Lower is better: cost per-token vs p50 latency". callout bubble for the recommended sweet spot (balanced routing) with arrow.
Sophie M.: inbound routing note — marketing needs recommended CTA / contact path. propose: "Try the latency-cost demo — request a dedicated trial" -> routes to sales if committed, otherwise self-serve demo. @Eli, can you draft CTAs?
Eli P.: yes. two CTAs: 1) "Run your workload — request a dedicated trial" (sales-assisted), 2) "Try hosted API with benchmark kit" (self-serve). include links to the benchmark kit repo.
Sophie M.: timeline: visuals by Jordan by tomorrow noon, Marco final numbers by EOD, Eli draft copy by tomorrow morning. I'll assemble slide and short launch post.
Jordan D.: noted — will push SVG + PNG to /design/bench-assets and drop sprite names here.
Marco L.: uploading verified table now. small note: p95 can spike for batching; we should surface p50 for latency story but include p95 in appendix.
Eli P.: good call. we'll state p50 in headline, and have a footnote: "p95 shown in appendix — batching increases tail latency for some workloads."
Sophie M.: final ask — keep the headline tight and measurable. no marketing fluff. objective: explain tradeoffs and show clear econ lever for platform teams. :heavy_check_mark:
Jordan D.: quick mock attached in thread (uploaded). happy to iterate.
Sophie M.: thanks team — will compile and set a dry-run on Thursday 10am. :calendar:
